item.title: STUDY: Political bumper stickers make bad driving more likely to draw honks
item.description: 'People are more likely to respond with hostility to bad drivers, if those bad drivers are displaying an out-partisan bumper sticker.'

item.title: Purdue introduces ‘AI working competency’ graduation requirement
item.description: Purdue University is introducing “artificial intelligence working competency” requirements for all of its undergraduates, effective in the 2026-2027 academic year. Experts told The College Fix the move is necessary and said Purdue is likely just the first of many universities to adopt such a policy. Completing the discipline-specific AI curricula will be a requirement for […]

item.title: ‘Feminist Collective’ took over political science journal, prioritized DEI: report
item.description: Studying the Constitution is not a priority for the American Political Science Association's journal, a new Goldwater Institute report found.

item.title: ‘Cruel behavior’: Northwestern U. LGBT community triggered by obscure flag painted on rock
item.description: Trump somehow to blame for Northwestern's reaction to the painted rock.

item.title: ‘Kill JD Vance’: UMass radio host resigns after social media comment
item.description: A radio host at University of Massachusetts in Lowell resigned after making a violent threat about Vice President JD Vance.

item.title: Scholar decries AI TikTok animal channel as ‘Blakface,’ ‘cultural appropriation’
item.description: Australian scholar Tamika Worrell critiques a TikTok channel featuring an AI-generated "Aboriginal man," calling it a new form of cultural appropriation akin to "blakface."

item.title: UMich cardiologist says school right to pause trans procedures for kids
item.description: A trained cardiologist says the risks of transgender drugs do not outweigh the potential benefits.

item.title: Race & equity professor upset Trump is countering progressive Renee Good narrative
item.description: USC professor Shaun Harper criticizes the Trump administration for allegedly distorting facts surrounding the Renee Good shooting. He argues that their narrative politicizes her death while underscoring the significance of student perspectives. Harper's stance contrasts with the belief of many Republicans who view the ICE agent’s shooting as justified.

item.title: Clemson students question continued ouster of professor over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: Clemson students are miffed that Professor Melvin Villaver, fired for controversial comments about Charlie Kirk's assassination, has not been reinstated. Students describe him as compassionate and supportive, calling for his case to be revisited following a colleague's settlement. They argue that freedom of speech should extend to professors, expressing concern over his termination.

item.title: Penn worries about Venezuelan students post- Trump invasion; student paper cites only critical Democrats
item.description: Following the U.S. invasion of Venezuela, the University of Pennsylvania reached out to Venezuelan students for support. However, a student paper highlighted only critical Democratic politicians, and ignored polls showing massive Venezuelan support for U.S. military action.
